name: Linn 808 electro machine
desc: Syncopated TR-808 electro kick/clap chassis with LinnDrum pickup fills, ghost-gain 808 hats panning slowly across the stereo field, and phrase-end double-time fills. Classic machine funk for deep-sea electro.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ bd [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.62).room(${room}), s("~ ~ ~ [~ sd sd ~]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.45).mask("<0 0 0 1>"), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(".5 .25 .38 .22 .48 .25 .4 .3").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("[~ oh]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.3)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.rev()).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ bd [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.66).room(${room}), s("sd*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("0 .22 .12 .3 0 .26 .14 .34"), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(.18,.5).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.32), s("cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.3)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
